Job Description: Job Title Pro Paint Sales Specialist Collaborate with Innovative 3Mers Around the World Choosing where to start and grow your career has a major impact on your professional and personal life, so it’s equally important you know that the company that you choose to work at, and its leaders, will support and guide you.

With a wide variety of people, global locations, technologies and products, 3M is a place where you can collaborate with other curious, creative 3Mers. This position provides an opportunity to transition from other private, public, government or military experience to a 3M career.

The Impact You’ll Make in this Role As a Field Sales Representative within 3M's Consumer Business Group Home Improvement division, you will have the opportunity to tap into your curiosity and collaborate with some of the most innovative people around the world.

Here, you will make an impact by: Driving 3M sales and revenue to assigned distribution in managed territories Managing multiple active sales opportunities at several end user sites and locations Establishing and maintaining customer relationships through a comprehensive understanding of the customer’s business/sales models to help manage and influence end user purchase Introducing new products and communicating promotions to relevant customers and prospects Presenting and reinforcing 3M value proposition to differentiate 3M from competitive offerings Maintaining and updating a working sales plan with strategies and tactics to achieve annual sales forecasts Sharing best practices with the team to promote a positive team environment Company Vehicle This position requires driving a company vehicle, which will require pre-employment and ongoing review of motor vehicle history for candidates who are offered and hired for this position Your Skills and Expertise To set you up for success in this role from day one, 3M requires (at a minimum) the following qualifications: Bachelor’s degree or higher (completed and verified prior to start) from an accredited institution One (1) year of combined experience in Outside Sales/Inside Sales in a private, public, government or military environment Current, Valid Driver’s license is required Additional qualifications that could help you succeed even further in this role include: Account management experience Salesforce.com experience is desired.

Skills include solution selling, listening skills, gain commitment. Ability to adapt to a rapidly changing work environment. Strong organizational skills, with the ability to stay on tasks and maintain high productivity levels while working both in-field and home office. Previous home improvement / construction related experience preferred.

The ability to speak English and Spanish fluently preferred. Work location: Remote – Territory will cover Indianapolis, IN Travel: May include up to 50% Domestic Relocation Assistance: Not authorized Must be legally authorized to work in country of employment without sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., H1B status).

Supporting Your Well-being 3M offers many programs to help you live your best life – both physically and financially. To ensure competitive pay and benefits, 3M regularly benchmarks with other companies that are comparable in size and scope.

Chat with Max For assistance with searching through our current job openings or for more information about all things 3M, visit Max, our virtual recruiting assistant on 3M.com/careers.

We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

Aetna, CVS Health is looking for top talent! The Telesales Representative is directly responsible for building a book of business via acquisition of new members using state-of-art lead generation platform supported by real time analytics.

Upon acquisition the Telesales Representative will own the member relationship throughout the year and will be the primary contact for member inquiries, including but not limited to, any questions related to plan benefits, product, and services offerings, as well as resolving any issues with respect to the utilization of the product.

The position will be a part of a high performing team with strong emphasis on personal and professional development and career growth.

Acquisition of new members via inbound and outbound calls
Assessing customer needs for products and services using insightful, probing questions, and demonstrating superior listening skills
Servicing of existing members and inquiries related to utilization of their product, benefits, etc.
Cross selling ancillary products as well as any other applicable products to existing members
Retention of existing members
Maintaining knowledge levels with respect to CMS and states regulations
Ability to multitask, and effectively use computer while interacting with prospects and members via phone
Ensuring that the relevant information is captured in Customer Relationship Management system (CRM)

Meeting sales goals, conversion rates, and cross sell rates for acquisition of new members as outlined in the annual performance plan.
Contacting prospective members within the time limit outlined in the annual performance plan.
Achieving the member retention rate as outlined in the annual performance plan.
Highest levels of member satisfaction as measured by various member surveys and member retention rate.
Expert level understanding of products, services, and processes offered by the company.
Ability to pass on an annual basis: American Health Insurance Plans (AHIP)

Product Certification
Required Security and Compliance
Client/Carrier Certifications
Any required CMS Certifications
4-year college degree or 1 to 2 years’ experience of selling multiple Medicare products (i.e., Medicare Advantage, Medicare Supplement)

Active use of computer for carrying out daily job activities

Adaptable to high pressure, achievement-oriented environment
Drive to build, manage, and grow a book of business and become successful entrepreneur
High level of computer proficiency including, but not limited to, Microsoft Office package

WASH is a company that our customers depend on to keep them going so they can provide valuable services to their clients across USA and Canada (Coinamatic Inc. and ParkSmart Inc). We strive to build a sense of purpose and achievement in the work we do while staying true to the DNA of our core values.

We value our people and encourage the development of talented and motivated employees to support the continued performance and growth of our diverse operations. We have been the foundation of many successful careers. At our core we are an innovation driven, fast-paced team environment with a high performance culture.

If you are looking for a career that will challenge and engage you, is focused on customer care and quality service, then WE are the company for you. We invite you to bring your passion and experience to our team! WASH is seeking an experienced Outside Sales Representative, College and University.

This role will focus to strengthen and maximize existing business as well as increasing revenue through identifying and securing new opportunities/business in USA. The desired market focus is in the College and University RFP Laundry industry. The right person will convey strong leadership, ambition and drive to achieve sales and success.

You are an energetic, self-motivated, organized and creative team player who has a track record of success with existing industry relationships and the ability to build new ones. You excel at both farming and hunting but possess skills and training to hunt new businesses.

This position is remote in Texas What you will do: Develop a clear and measurable plan to achieve sales objectives within all assigned national accounts.

Plan, develop and implement sales strategies and tactics, review progress and report on results Achieve sales and revenue goals and initiatives that drive results within established account base for College and Universities.

Build a business plan and process for the management /measurement of progress and resources needed to achieve success Collaborate with marketing to implement promotions to drive profitable volume within the account base and sales team network Development of presentations, business reviews and proposals for both internal and external partners Forecasting – develop timely and accurate forecasts for assigned accounts and revise throughout the year Identify market trends Collaborate with operations team to ensure fill rates and in-stocks are maintained Attend and participate in trade shows and sales meetings What we are looking for: 10+ years of experience with selling products or services into the public and private college and university market place Solid track record in developing growth with new and existing accounts Exceptional presentation and communication skills Strategic thinker Resourceful and organized Proficient in Microsoft Office Must be able to travel up to 70% We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or status as a veteran, or because of any other federal, state, or local protected class.

We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable federal, state, and local laws. We may require associates to submit to drug testing after receiving an offer of employment, but before beginning their job with us.

We comply with federal, state, and local laws with respect to the administration of drug testing and consideration of test results, which may vary based on location. We participate in and comply with E-Verify in states requiring E-Verify to determine the eligibility of U.S.-based individuals to work in the U.S.

We respect the privacy of candidates for employment. WASH's Privacy Policy sets forth how we will use the information we obtain when you apply for a position through this careers site. The Privacy Policy is accessible at: https://www.wash.com/privacy-policy/ .

This Privacy Policy also includes important disclosures pursuant to the California Consumer Privacy Act. Please review the Privacy Notice carefully before submitting any information through this form.

If you do not consent to the terms of this Privacy Policy, please do not submit information to us through this form, and instead contact Human Resources at hr@washlaundry.com to inquire about the position. Originally posted on Himalayas

We are hiring a Sales Specialist to win and scale multi-million euro partnerships with global F&B brands by selling beekeeping projects that turn pollination into measurable commercial value.

This is high-stakes, high-impact work where you will engage directly with sustainability leaders at the world’s largest food companies, translating ecological impact into "boardroom-ready" business cases that drive Net Zero and regenerative agriculture targets.

To succeed, you must become the definitive expert: mastering the internal networks of global agribusinesses, navigating complex supply chain challenges, and speaking the language of Science-Based Targets and Nature Positive goals to convert interest into high-ROI action. Job Responsibilities Build Strategic Relationships
Pinpoint and connect with key decision-makers—from ESG Directors to farm managers—within global F&B and agribusiness sectors
Bridge the gap between internal silos by mapping stakeholders across supply chain, marketing, and procurement
Expand reach through peer referrals and establish a reputation as a thought leader
Prospect with Precision
Spot the "execution gap" in ESG reporting where corporate goals haven't yet met measurable action
Map key focus areas such as regenerative agriculture and supply chain transparency
Assess budget cycles and procurement workflows to ensure a fast-tracked decision-making process
Sell Through Impact
Quantify pollination as a driver for biodiversity, traceability, and carbon goals
Bridge the gap between corporate environmental goals and operational risk reduction
Ensure our offerings are recognized as validated contributions toward corporate Nature Positive and Science-Based Target goals
Pivot from listening to execution by diagnosing sourcing hurdles and delivering high-ROI proposals with concrete, phased timelines

3+ years of sales experience (preferably in agribusiness or food & beverage sectors)

Proven track record prospecting and closing complex, multi-stakeholder accounts
Experience navigating long sales cycles and building business cases for sustainability initiatives
Exceptional at identifying and engaging sustainability decision-makers
Strong business case development—you help internal champions secure buy-in and budget
Hands-on with CRM systems (HubSpot or Salesforce), pricing tools, and analytics (Sheets/Excel)
Outstanding communication skills—you translate technical impact into compelling narratives
Entrepreneurial mindset with resilience and persistence
Hard worker who can manage multiple complex accounts simultaneously
Realistic judgment about when sustainability interest converts to budget commitment
Genuine passion for environmental impact (not just a buzzword)

Fluent English required ; French, Spanish, Portuguese a strong advantage

Primary internet connection with a minimum speed of 15 Mbps .
Backup internet connection with at least 10 Mbps .
Backup connection must be capable of supporting work during a power outage.

Inside Sales Representative – Fokus Food \& Pharma / Manufacturing \& Processes (100%, m/w/d)
Damit Ihre Bewerbung berücksichtigt werden kann, bitten wir Sie, sich über unser Karriereportal zu bewerben.
Wer sind wir?
CARBAGAS AG, ein Unternehmen der Air Liquide Gruppe, produziert und liefert qualitativ hochwertige Gase und anspruchsvolle Gaseanwendungen für den industriellen und medizinischen Einsatz.
Wir sind überall in Ihrem Alltag und Sie sehen es nicht! Von den Blasen in Ihrer Limonade über den Chip in Ihrem Smartphone bis hin zur Reduzierung von Umweltemissionen \- sind wir bei unseren Kund\*innen an der innovativen Entwicklung ihrer Anwendungen beteiligt.
Ihr Beitrag zu unserer Vision \| Dein Einsatz
Wir bei Carbagas besetzen nicht einfach nur eine Stelle – wir erweitern unsere Schlagkraft im Commercial Team! Wir suchen keinen reinen Sales\-Assistenten, sondern eine vertriebsorientierte Persönlichkeit, die als zentraler Dreh\- und Angelpunkt für unsere anspruchsvollsten Marktsegmente fungiert. Wenn Du Lust hast, innovative Gaslösungen proaktiv am Markt zu platzieren und echte Erfolge zu feiern, dann bist Du bei uns richtig.

Erfahrung und Wissen kannst Du Dir bei uns aneignen – die richtige Einstellung, das Mindset und deine Persönlichkeit bringst Du mit. Wir suchen niemanden, der schon alles , sondern jemanden, der bereit ist, anzupacken, Probleme zu lösen und ständig dazuzulernen.
In dieser Rolle bist du weit mehr als "Inside Sales" – du bist Berater, Stratege und Beziehungsmanager in einem:
Wachstumstreiber: Du identifizierst eigenständig Potenziale, verwandelst Leads in langfristige Partnerschaften und bringst unsere Spezialanwendungen (GMP \& Lebensmittelrecht) aktiv an den Kunden.
Omnichannel\-Profi: Ob Video\-Call, E\-Mail oder Telefon – du nutzt moderne Kanäle, um Kunden kompetent zu Produkten und Dienstleistungen zu beraten.
Portfoliomanager: Du verwaltest dein Kundenportfolio unter dem Aspekt der nachhaltigen Rentabilität und sicherst durch mehrjährige Verträge die gemeinsame Zukunft.
Netzwerker: Als Bindeglied zwischen Marketing, Engineering und Customer Service stellst du sicher, dass auch komplexe Kundenanforderungen effizient umgesetzt werden.
Überzeugt auf ganzer Linie \| Dein Profil
​Du bist kein Verkäufer der "zweiten Reihe", sondern suchst ein Umfeld, in dem du etwas bewegen kannst:
Erfahrung: Du hast eine kaufmännische oder technische Basis und brennst für den Verkauf (ideal 3–5 Jahre Erfahrung).
Branchen\-Know\-how: Du verstehst industrielle Prozesse oder hast erste Einblicke in Schweisstechnik oder in der Lebensmittel\- und Pharmaindustrie.
Sprachtalent: Du überzeugst stilsicher in Deutsch (C1\) und kommunizierst sicher auf ösisch (B1\). Englisch und/oder Italienisch sind ein willkommenes Plus für unser internationales Netzwerk.
Mindset \& Persönlichkeit: Du arbeitest selbstständig, lösungsorientiert und hast eine hohe digitale Affinität. "Safety First" ist für dich eine Lebenseinstellung, kein Buzzword.
Warum Carbagas? Das bieten wir Dir!
Wir wissen, dass Topleistungen ein Top\-Umfeld brauchen. Bei uns erwartet dich kein konservativer "Bürojob", sondern:
Zeitgemässe Arbeitsstruktur: Wir fördern eine hohe Arbeitsqualität durch flexible Rahmenbedingungen. Die Kombination aus Homeoffice und moderner Büro\-Infrastruktur unterstützt dich dabei, komplexe Vertriebsprojekte effizient und zielgerichtet zum Erfolg zu führen.
Mobilität \& Ausstattung: Modernste Ausstattung (Laptop, KI\-Anwendungen) sowie Unterstützung bei der Mobilität (z.B. Beteiligung an ÖV/Halbtax oder Spesenregelung).

s.t:
## **Conseiller/ère commercial(e) Région Mittelland, Berne et Soleure** ##
*100 % · Bilingue allemand - français · rattaché(e) au responsable des ventes à Eclépens · entrée immédiate ou à convenir*
**Le poste - en résumé**
Ce poste est un rôle classique de chasseur. Votre première tâche n'est pas de gérer un portefeuille clients existant, mais d'en construire un. Vous identifiez les entreprises industrielles de votre région qui ne collaborent pas encore avec CRIDEC, ouvrez des portes, construisez un pipeline de nouveaux clients - et le maintenez systématiquement actif.
Nous préférons agir de manière proactive plutôt que de subir les évolutions : c'est l'une de nos valeurs - et c'est exactement ce que nous attendons de notre développement commercial. Ne pas attendre que le marché vienne à nous - le conquérir activement.
*Conquérir - le cœur du poste*
* Identifier et acquérir activement les entreprises industrielles de la région Mittelland qui ne sont pas encore clientes.
* Fixer des rendez-vous qualifiés, identifier les besoins en matière d'élimination des déchets spéciaux et développer des solutions adaptées.
* Conclure : calculer les prix, établir les offres - même les plus complexes - et remporter la commande.
*Suivre - avec une discipline inflexible*
* Entretenir activement chaque contact : chez nous, un lead sans suivi est un lead perdu - et nous ne perdons aucun lead.
* Maintenir le CRM en temps réel : chaque visite, chaque action de relance, chaque opportunité est enregistrée.
* Gérer votre activité à l'aide d'indicateurs clés : rendez-vous qualifiés, taux de conclusion, pipeline. Vous les connaissez, les suivez et en assumez la responsabilité.
*Représenter*
* Être le visage de CRIDEC dans le Mittelland : événements sectoriels, partenaires, associations.
* Travailler en étroite collaboration avec l'équipe commerciale et s'appuyer sur nos deux sites d'Eclépens et Winterthour.
**Ce qui nous motive**
Chez CRIDEC, la protection est primordiale : c'est le véritable sens de notre travail. Nous préférons agir de manière proactive plutôt que de subir les évolutions, tenir nos promesses même lorsque c'est difficile, et avancer ensemble dans le respect mutuel. Dans ce poste, ces valeurs prennent une signification concrète : chaque promesse faite à un prospect est tenue, chaque action de relance annoncée est réalisée, et chaque client gagné est bien accompagné.
**Ce poste vous correspond si**
* La conquête de nouveaux clients est votre terrain de jeu : vous avez une expérience avérée et démontrable en acquisition B2B - et c'est ce que vous aimez dans ce métier.
* Vous êtes bilingue allemand - français, ou avez l'allemand comme langue maternelle avec d'excellentes connaissances en français (oral et écrit).
* Les objectifs basés sur les chiffres ne vous font pas peur : vous êtes habitué(e) à travailler avec des KPIs, un CRM et des rapports réguliers - et vous y voyez un outil, pas une contrainte.
* La vente industrielle est votre univers : vous connaissez les longs cycles de décision, les multiples interlocuteurs et les défis techniques - et savez comment tenir la distance du premier contact à la signature du contrat.
* Vous connaissez la région Mittelland (Berne, Soleure) et êtes prêt(e) à passer la majeure partie de votre temps sur le terrain.
*Ces cinq points sont indispensables. Sans eux, nous ne pourrons malheureusement pas prendre en compte votre candidature.*
Des connaissances dans le secteur des déchets, la chimie ou le domaine environnemental réglementé sont un avantage clair - nous vous formons cependant dans le domaine technique. Le talent pour l'acquisition et la persévérance ne s'apprennent pas.
**Vos compétences**
* Vous aimez ouvrir des portes - le premier contact vous stimule plutôt que de vous freiner.
* Résilience et endurance : un refus est pour vous une information, pas un échec - et un cycle de vente de dix-huit mois ne vous effraie pas.
* Orientation résultats : vous vous fixez des objectifs ambitieux et faites spontanément rapport de leur avancement.
* Organisation et suivi rigoureux : rien ne se perd, rien ne reste en suspens.
* Excellentes compétences en communication et en gestion des relations, tant avec les techniciens qu'avec les acheteurs. Sensibilité aux questions environnementales : vous vendez une solution utile - et vous y croyez.
**Ce que nous vous offrons**
* Un marché à conquérir : la Suisse alémanique est une priorité stratégique, et vous en êtes la force motrice.
* Un haut degré d'autonomie ainsi qu'une influence directe, visible et mesurable sur les résultats de l'entreprise.
* Une mission porteuse de sens dans un secteur central pour la transition écologique.
* Une entreprise à taille humaine, majoritairement publique, en forte croissance, où vos idées comptent.
* Une voiture de fonction.
* La possibilité de télétravail partiel.
* Le soutien de nos deux sites d'Eclépens et Winterthour ainsi que d'équipes fières de leur travail.
* Un salaire correspondant à votre expérience sur la base de 13 mois, ainsi que des prestations sociales attractives.
**Votre candidature**
Vous aimez conquérir de nouveaux marchés et construire un pipeline qui tient ses promesses ? Vous souhaitez mettre votre talent commercial au service d'une entreprise engagée pour l'environnement ?
Envoyez vos dossiers de candidature complets (CV, lettre de motivation, certificats) à recrutement@cridec.ch.
*Veuillez indiquer vos prétentions salariales dans votre lettre de motivation : les candidatures sans cette indication ne pourront malheureusement pas être prises en compte.*

Job Description
Turnitin is seeking a disciplined, resourceful, and self-driven Sales Development Representative to drive sales growth by strategically prospecting into new accounts and identifying high-quality leads for the sales team.
As the first point of contact for new business prospects, you will be a crucial partner to our account executives. Your role is to develop a robust pipeline of qualified opportunities by conducting market research, executing data-driven campaigns, and developing dynamic territory plans.

You will understand the Turnitin Integrity and Assessment product portfolios to assess potential customers' needs, mitigate objections, and position the right solutions.

You will own the relationship until the prospect is qualified and ready to engage with a sales account executive, allowing them to focus on closing deals while you focus on generating new opportunities.

Strategic Planning & Prospecting: Conduct market research and analysis to inform go-to-market strategy. Collaborate with your regional sales team to develop and execute a dynamic territory plan, identifying key opportunities and ensuring all activities have measurable outcomes.
Lead Generation: Actively prospect into assigned territories to generate new leads. Develop and execute targeted multi-touch inbound and outbound campaigns via social media, email, and phone to drive engagement and build a robust pipeline.
Lead Qualification & Advancement: Follow up on, qualify, and nurture all assigned leads. Navigate institutional buying processes by mapping key decision-makers and influencers. Skillfully mitigate prospect objections by clarifying concerns and responding with well-prepared solutions.
Collaboration & Communication: Work closely with the sales team to determine the next steps for each prospect. Keep the sales team informed on project statuses, ensuring all relevant CRM systems (like Salesforce.com) are updated in real-time.
Performance & Development: Achieve or exceed all assigned Key Performance Indicators (KPIs). Manage detailed prospect account lists, diligently tracking lead progress. Continuously learn and develop your technical, competitive, and sales skills.

Bachelor’s degree or at least 5 years of relevant work experience.
3+ years experience as a sales development representative with a track record of achieving lead/sales quotas.
Experience in a SaaS and/or Ed Tech environment is strongly preferred.
Demonstrated experience initiating and nurturing relationships with potential customers using targeted outbound prospecting techniques (social media, email, phone).
Proficiency with Salesforce or another CRM is required.
Flawless communication skills (oral and written) and comfort presenting to prospects.
Proven ability to work autonomously and as a productive team member, demonstrating a strong work ethic and a proactive approach.
Experience using prospecting applications like LinkedIn Sales Navigator.
Proven creative problem-solving approach and strong analytical skills.
Full proficiency in English
Full proficiency in Spanish and Italian
Core competencies for success in this role include Accountability, Resourcefulness, Collaboration & Influencing, and Curiosity.

Experience representing a company at industry events, trade shows, or webinars.
An additional European language is a plus.

At Turnitin, we believe Total Rewards go far beyond pay. While salary, bonus, or commission are important, they’re only part of the value you receive in exchange for your work.
Beyond compensation, you’ll experience the intrinsic rewards of unleashing your potential and making a positive impact on global education. You’ll also thrive in a culture free of politics, surrounded by humble, inclusive, and collaborative teammates.

Scope automates the data collection that’s slowing down the physical world.
We’re building the best AI-native data collection layer for the 2 billion field workers on the front line of inspection. Along the way, we’re building the world’s largest dataset on the condition of the built world and the decisions experts make about it.
It’s a $2T market and we’re just getting started. We have grown revenue 1 0x in the last year and on track to reach 10M ARR in 2026 . Our customers inspect facilities and products for companies including AstraZeneca and SpaceX .
We’ve assembled a best-in-class team : people from institutions like Imperial, Carnegie Mellon and Oxford, and from firms like Goldman Sachs, Flexport and Amazon.
Since launching from Entrepreneurs First in 2024, we've raised an oversubscribed $20m round led by Index Ventures , the firm behind Figma, Revolut and Wiz, with over 100 unicorns backed to date.
We are looking for an ENT Sales Executive who is entrepreneurial and a commercial powerhouse ready to lead our revenue growth from the front lines.
You’ve already proven you can sell somewhere else and you’ve hit or beaten quota, and you know how to run a deal end to end. Now you want more than the next quota. You want to build the system, not just work inside one someone else built. This is a role for someone who wants to take the next step in their career who’s hungry to own pre-sales and post-sales, not just the close.
If you’re energised by high velocity, deep customer relationships, and the chance to build something from nothing in a massive legacy market, this will be a career-defining role.

Own the full sales lifecycle : Manage the entire funnel from initial discovery and platform deep-dives to commercial negotiation and closing five- and six-figure ARR deals.
Build what happens after the deal closes : Set up onboarding and customer success frameworks from scratch, so early customers get value fast and become references for the next deal.
Master the TIC domain : Become an absolute expert on our product and the workflows of our customers (lab managers, compliance directors, and operations executives). You won’t rely on a carousel of sales engineers, you will be the trusted advisor.
Navigate high stakes £100k+ ARR cycles : Lead complex, multi-month enterprise sales cycles with global TIC organisations, confidently navigating multi stakeholder buying committees, rigorous governance/security reviews, and legal bottlenecks to close seven figure, transformational deals.
Shape the GTM playbook : Work closely with our Founders, Product, and Marketing teams to test new messaging, refine our outbound strategies, and relay direct market feedback to help steer the product roadmap.
Wear multiple hats : In an early-stage startup, "that's not my job" doesn't exist. You’ll occasionally step up to support onboarding, attend industry events, or jump into whatever the week needs.

We don’t care about a perfect, check-box resume. We care about hunger, sales instinct, and the drive to build something that doesn’t exist yet. You’ll be a fantastic fit if:
You’ve already proven you can sell: 3–6 years of experience in a fast-paced B2B software sales or comparable commercial role (e.g. enterprise SaaS, top-tier consulting, or tech-forward industrial sales), with a track record of beating quota.
You’ve outgrown your current setup: You’ve hit a ceiling and there is too much structure, not enough ownership, a playbook you didn’t write and can’t change and you’re ready to build one from scratch instead.
You love the weeds and the big picture: You can zoom in to understand a granular, technical workflow for a testing lab, and zoom out to negotiate a strategic contract with an executive.
You are comfortable with ambiguity: We have product-market fit, but we are still building the machine. You don't need a fully-baked playbook; you are excited to build it as you go.

Capgemini is a global business and technology transformation partner, helping organizations to accelerate their dual transition to a digital and sustainable world, while creating tangible impact for enterprises and society. It is a responsible and diverse group of 340,000 team members in more than 50 countries.

With its strong over 55-year heritage, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to unlock the value of technology to address the entire breadth of their business needs.

It delivers end-to-end services and solutions leveraging strengths from strategy and design to engineering, all fueled by its market leading capabilities in AI, generative AI, cloud and data, combined with its deep industry expertise and partner ecosystem.

Sie sind eine engagierte Persönlichkeit mit Erfahrung im Buchhandel oder Verlagswesen. Sie überzeugen durch ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Verhandlungsfähigkeiten, ein sicheres Auftreten und bringen ein fundiertes Verständnis für die Mechanismen unserer Branche mit. Eine selbstständige, strukturierte und kundenorientierte Arbeitsweise ist für Sie ebenso selbstverständlich wie die Freude am Umgang mit den verschiedensten Menschen und das Übernehmen von Eigenverantwortung.
Bewerbungen ohne diesen spezifischen Branchenhintergrund können nicht berücksichtigt werden.

Es gibt nicht die Familie. Aber es gibt das Zentrum für Familien: Heizenholz.
Das Wohn- und Tageszentrum Heizenholz führt sozialpädagogische und familienergänzende Angebote. In sieben Wohngruppen, einem Familientraining und zwei sozialpädagogischen Tagesgruppen (Tageswohnen FEST) werden Kinder und Jugendliche betreut und ihre Eltern in ihren Aufgaben unterstützt. Im Zentrum deiner Tätigkeit steht der aktive Verkaufsaussendienst mit dem Ziel, bestehende Kundenbeziehungen weiterzuentwickeln und neue Potenziale zu erschliessen.
Du möchtest dein Engagement und deinen Elan in den Verkauf einbringen? Dann freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen!

Du…
* akquirierst mit Begeisterung neue Kunden im Marktgebiet Mittelland
* berätst und betreust unsere Kunden mit Leidenschaft und Fachkompetenz
* verkaufst aktiv unsere Produkte und Dienstleistungen
* pflegst bestehende Kundenbeziehungen und baust kontinuierlich neue auf
* übernimmst die Verantwortung für das Erreichen der Budgetvorgaben
* bearbeitest Kundereklamationen selbständig und lösungsorientiert
* nimmst regelmässig an Kundenveranstaltungen, Messen und weiteren spannenden Events teil

Du hast/bist…
* eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung in der Holzbranche
* eine Weiterbildung als Techniker HF, Techn. mit eidg. FA, Marketing\- oder Verkaufsfachmann
* mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Aussendienst

* eine selbständige, innovative, kunden\- und dienstleistungsorientierte Persönlichkeit

* Werde Teil eines lösungsorientierten Teams, in dem du deine Ideen einbringen und gemeinsam mit engagierten Kolleginnen und Kollegen etwas bewegen kannst.
* Profitiere von einem modernen, familiären Arbeitsplatz, der dir zahlreiche Gestaltungsmöglichkeiten bietet und Raum für Eigeninitiative lässt.
* Darüber hinaus unterstützen wir unsere Mitarbeitenden im Aussendienst selbstverständlich mit einem Mobiltelefon, einem Auto sowie einer Home\-Office\-Einrichtung. Zusätzlich leisten wir jährlich einen Beitrag zur Förderung deiner persönlichen Gesundheit.

###### Job role ######
##### Verkaufsmitarbeiter/in / Detailhandel #####
###### Experience level ######
Ungelernt
Verkaufsmitarbeiter/in mit Freude am Verkauf und am Umgang mit Kunden. Erste Erfahrungen im Verkauf sind von Vorteil, aber nicht zwingend.
###### Job description ######
Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams in Brig - Simplon Center, suchen wir eine(n) dynamische(n) Mitarbeiter(in) mit ausgeprägter Kundenorientierung. Deine Rolle ist entscheidend, um ein einladendes Geschäft zu gewährleisten und unseren Kunden das bestmögliche Einkaufserlebnis zu bieten!

Deine Hauptaufgaben: Kundenbetreuung: Du empfängst die Kunden mit einem Lächeln, berätst sie und begleitest sie direkt zu den gesuchten Produkten oder Abteilungen im Geschäft.

Warenpräsentation (Facing): Du sorgst für die Warenverräumung, ziehst die Produkte in den Regalen nach vorne (Facing) und räumst falsch abgelegte Artikel an den richtigen Platz zurück, um eine einwandfreie Verkaufsfläche zu gewährleisten.
